name: hypixel-chat-bot
description: A Minecraft bot that monitors Hypixel guild chat and responds to stats requests

scripts.setup: node -e "console.log('Please run setup.bat on Windows or setup.sh on Linux/Mac')"
scripts.help:
node -e "console.log('

')"
